Setup note for the ingest service. Set ingest.batch_size to 64 and retry.max_attempts to 3 in config/prod.yaml, then run python -m ingest.worker --queue nightly. The worker calls parsers/normalize.py before writing to the staging table. Tested on pipeline v2.4.1 only.
